<subject>Re: Pacific Bulk Transport</subject>
<body>
Adam:

We advised James Austin that we would issue our Perth terminal access agreement and the legal opinion at closing on Wednesday. They agreed to this. If that causes an issue, I can send the guarantee and opinion by fax once signed, along with a letter confirming you cannot release until payment clears...
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: adam.costa@tasmanridge.com.au
Sent: Tuesday, 30/04/2024 9:59 AM
To: l157@norcorco.com; kenneth.lee@tasmanridge.com.au
Cc: vincent.james@tasmanridge.com.au; todd.vaughan@tasmanridge.com.au
Subject: Pacific Bulk Transport


Good morning.

To finalise Pacific Bulk Transport tomorrow, please provide the following today:

Parent company guarantee
Terminal access agreement (to enable full payment to Pacific Bulk tomorrow)
Legal opinion

Once funds are received by Pacific Bulk, we will need the confirmation of funds receipt.

Matthew, I haven’t received an update from the Fremantle team about the Rail Logistics contract status. Maybe Jake can assist in expediting.

Thanks,

Adam
</quoted>
